name: Visual Pack
description: Every visual enhancement in one pack, each its own OPTIONS row and on/off ladder (all default OFF): a unified SKY & WEATHER system (time-of-day lighting, night stars, and weather that varies by map and real day), plus CRT lines, vignette, letterbox, ambient motes, RGB split, film grain, color grade, and duotone. Pure graphics - the settings hub lives in the separate 'settings' mod now, so you can archive this pack freely. Safe overlay/shader techniques with fallbacks; no engine files edited.
